name: vault-bridge
description: Obsidian vault ↔ project bridge for Claude Code: manifest cache, haiku read-only vault-searcher agent (read/write asymmetry — vault reads delegable, writes are main-context only via the Write Role Contract), main-context write-primitive skills (/vault-link, /vault-commit, /vault-manifest-refresh), and deterministic no-LLM SessionStart/PreToolUse hooks, with .vault-link project binding.

vault_path.title: Vault Path
vault_path.description: Absolute path to your Obsidian vault root (e.g. ~/vault or /Users/me/my-vault). Exposed to hooks as VAULT_BRIDGE_VAULT_PATH. Use VAULT_BRIDGE_VAULT_ROOT env var to override at runtime.
